custody_breakdown.note: LlamaRisk's Unallocated bucket (which THEY label liquid cash) minus live + monthly attributed custody. We make no claim about what this is: the known instances are DeFi positions and tokenized credit-fund shares, not cash. Absorbs both growth since the monthly snapshot and any holdings our wallet read cannot see.

onchain_bucket_vs_attested.note: Ethena's onchain-wallet bucket vs the wallets we read. The aligned pair is the meaningful one: taken days apart, it measures SCOPE — what the attested bucket counts that our wallet read does not — rather than a month of drift. The difference is what the custody residual absorbs, so it is stated here rather than left unnamed.

risk_flags.message: Onchain-wallet bucket across 6 of 13 disclosed accounts read on 2026-09-27; 7 tracked today have no reading that day, so their snapshot balances are unmeasured: our read $1.91B on 2026-09-27 vs $2.62B attested at the 2026-09-27 snapshot (-27.3%, 0d apart) — dates aligned, so this is scope, not drift; live today $2.32B

notes.custody_vs_total: custody_breakdown sums to LlamaRisk 'Unallocated' (Liquid Cash); custody + cex_hedge ~= total_backing.
notes.defi_pie_scope: defi_protocol_breakdown is a drill-down of the Coinbase Onchain Wallets custody slice, not of total backing — do not double-count.
notes.wallet_data_cadence: coinbase_wallets / defi_protocol_breakdown come from FarmTracker's DAILY reserve export (wallet_data_generated_at); the rest of this blob is hourly.
notes.coinbase_wallets_naming: 'coinbase_wallets' and the 'Coinbase Onchain Wallets' custody slice keep Ethena's own label for this bucket, which files 13 accounts under it — 11 EVM plus 2 Solana, at least one of them Bitwise/Jupiter Lend rather than Coinbase custody. Totalling this as Coinbase-the-custodian overstates it. The name is kept so figures stay traceable to the attestation; read it as onchain wallets.
